nan.interpretation: NaN fails any 0<=x<=1 test; the portal message 'Predicted values must be in range [0, 1]' is explained by NaN inside the official footprint (nan variant). The allfinite variant passes the range test but emits ~12% of the footprint (~12x the dotted file's pixel count) and half of its positives lie outside the footprint.
